name: Декор — мелкая каменная россыпь
subject: ONE fantasy voxel environment dressing asset. Exactly SEVEN discrete small chunky warm gray gravel fragments, each one or two LARGE coarse cubes high, sparse loose irregular scatter with ample white gaps, no centre boulder, no dust or tiny confetti. Preserve the exact seven-piece arrangement in all rotations. NO earth, ground plane or base.
caption: Пять ракурсов одного варианта декора. Крупные воксели, чистый фон; без земли и демонстрационной подложки.
prompt_override: Create a BRAND NEW fantasy Minecraft-style voxel asset reference sheet. The supplied image is STYLE ONLY; do not copy its identity or geometry. Exactly FIVE separate complete views of ONE identical asset: front and back on upper row, left profile, right profile and isometric game view on lower row. Large axis-aligned cubes, flat square surfaces and broad coarse pixel material patches. Pure uniform white background, generous margins. NO text, annotations, arrows, panels, labels, ground, dirt, supporting plinth, cast/contact shadows or ambient occlusion. Mild face material color variation only. Subject: Exactly SEVEN very small isolated stone chips in a loose sparse uneven grouping, each ONLY ONE or TWO geometric cubes high and two or three cubes wide. No dominant piece. Highest fragment two stacked cubes strictly. Warm gray chunky broad material pixels, no moss, dirt, dust or confetti.
